mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200k signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 50% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 200k, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based pickup in consumer demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% in a month, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the year-over-year growth of real personal consumption (proxied by RSAFS) combined with a stable unemployment rate indicates resilient consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS YoY > 3% and UNRATE < 6.5%, or the interaction term's effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals that inflation is becoming a persistent concern, prompting market expectations of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS stable, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% and a rise in non-farm payroll growth above 150k signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.5% and PAYEMS increases > 150k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 5.5% and PAYEMS > 150k, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (quarterly) below 1.0% signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1.0%, or the signal's Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
